ai.text:
This bill would require the approved monument honoring Thomas Paine to be placed in Area 1 of the National Mall. That area is set aside for memorials of exceptional historical importance and lasting significance to the country.

Thomas Paine was a philosopher and writer. His pamphlet, Common Sense, argued that the American colonies should become independent from Great Britain.

summary.label: Congressional Research Service, Reported to House
summary.text:
Common Sense 250 Act of 2026
This bill requires the authorized monument honoring Thomas Paine to be located in Area 1 of the National Mall, which is reserved for commemorative works of preeminent historical and lasting significance to the United States. Thomas Paine was a philosopher and writer whose pamphlet, Common Sense, advocated for American independence from Great Britain.
